title: Hot Chicken Tenders with Creamy White Sauce
title_ms: Hot Chicken Tenders dengan Creamy White Sauce
description: Crispy fried chicken strips coated in a hot spiced oil, served with a cool, tangy yogurt-mayo dipping sauce.
description_ms: Isi ayam yang disalut tepung berlapis, digoreng crispy dan dimandikan dalam minyak berempah pedas, dihidang dengan sos krim putih dari yogurt dan mayo.
steps: Divide the chicken fried flour into two portions: mix one with water to form a wet batter; leave the other dry.
Dip chicken fillets cut into long strips into the wet batter, then coat with the dry flour.
Fry in very hot cooking oil until crispy and golden brown; drain and set aside.
In a bowl, combine 1 tbsp paprika powder, 1 tbsp cayenne pepper, 0.5 tbsp garlic powder, 0.5 tbsp chilli flakes, 1 tbsp brown sugar, and salt to taste.
Carefully ladle very hot oil from the frying pan directly over the spice mix to bloom the spices.
Toss the fried chicken in the spiced oil until every piece is evenly coated.
For the sauce: whisk together 3 tbsp plain yogurt, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, a squeeze of lemon juice, black pepper to taste, 2 cloves garlic (crushed), and salt to taste.
Serve the chicken tenders hot alongside the creamy white sauce.
steps_ms: Bahagikan tepung goreng ayam kepada 2 bahagian: satu dicampur dengan air untuk jadi basah, satu lagi kekal kering.
Celupkan isi ayam yang dipotong panjang ke dalam tepung basah, kemudian salit dengan tepung kering.
Goreng dalam minyak goreng betul-betul panas sehingga crispy golden brown, angkat dan tepi.
Dalam mangkuk, campurkan 1 sudu besar serbuk paprika, 1 sudu besar cayenne pepper, setengah sudu besar garlic powder, setengah sudu besar cili flakes, 1 sudu besar brown sugar, dan garam secukupnya.
Tuang minyak goreng yang betul-betul panas dari kuali ke atas campuran rempah tadi.
Masukkan ayam goreng ke dalam minyak berempah, kacau sehingga rempah melekat rata.
Untuk sos: campurkan 3 sudu besar yogurt original, 3 sudu besar mayonis, perahan lemon secukup rasa, black pepper, 2 ulas bawang putih yang dah ditumbuk hancur, dan garam — kacau sebati.
Hidangkan chicken tenders panas-panas bersama sos krim putih.
